title: A new laptop
subtitle: Choosing a laptop for the drawing course — as … as, the same, different from
canDo: I can say two things are the same or different with as … as.
I can ask which one is better and explain my choice.
I can ask about prices and a guarantee in a shop.
teacherNotes: as … as = Türkçede "kadar", Arapçada "مثل / بنفس درجة". not as … as yapısını "daha az" olarak gösterin: Boston isn't as big as New York = Boston daha küçük.
as … as arasında sıfatın normal hâli kullanılır; öğrenciler sık sık "as bigger as" der. Kırmızı kalemle düzeltme alıştırması yapın.
Rol oyunu: bir dükkânda iki ürünü karşılaştırma (telefon, ayakkabı, bisiklet). Öğrenciler fiyat ve garanti sorsun.
"I'll take it" alışverişte kullanılan kalıp bir ifade; will Ünite 8'de ayrıca işlenecek.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: The silver one or the black one?
sections.scene: Saturday afternoon. Elif and Lucas are in a computer shop on Green Street.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Hi there. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Yes, please. I need a laptop for a drawing course. My old one is too slow.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: OK. What about these two? The silver one is new, and the black one is used.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Is the black one as fast as the silver one?

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Yes, it is. They have the same memory. But the black one isn't as light. It's about half a kilo heavier.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: And the screen isn't as big.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: The silver one is six hundred and fifty dollars. The black one is four hundred and fifty.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Four hundred and fifty. That's much better. Does it have a guarantee?

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Yes. All our used laptops have a one-year guarantee, and the battery is new.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: But the silver one is nicer, Elif.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: It's nicer, but it isn't as cheap! I'm saving for my ticket home, remember? I'll take the black one.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Good choice. It's as good as new.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Good news, Dad!
sections.intro: Elif writes to her father the next day.
paragraphs: Good news: I'm starting a drawing course for future architects! It's free, and it's at the public library on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
We're going to learn a drawing program, so I needed a new laptop. My old one was a present from you six years ago, and now it's slower than a turtle!
Yesterday Lucas came with me to a computer shop on Green Street. The new laptops were too expensive, so I bought a used one.
It isn't as light as the new ones, and the screen isn't as big. But it's as fast as a new laptop, and it was two hundred dollars cheaper. There's a one-year guarantee too.
It cost $450. I paid with my café money. I know you want to pay half, but please don't. I can do it!
The course starts next Tuesday. I'm a little nervous: the other students are older than me, and some of them already work in architecture offices.
But I'm as excited as a child!

sections.title: Grammar: as … as, the same, different from
look: It's **as fast as** a new laptop.
It **isn't as light as** the new ones.

head: Example
Meaning
rows: The black one is **as fast as** the silver one.
It **isn't as light as** the silver one.
My phone is **the same as** yours.
New York is very **different from** Boston.

rules: Use the normal adjective between **as … as**: *as fast as* (not *as faster as*).
**not as … as** = less: *Boston isn't as big as New York* = Boston is smaller.
**Which one …?** = which of these things: *Which one do you want?*
examples: My English isn't as good as Omar's.
Is the bus as fast as the subway?
Your phone is the same as mine.
Izmir is very different from Boston.

support.tr: as + sıfat + as = "kadar": as fast as = kadar hızlı. Olumsuzu not as … as = "… kadar … değil": Boston isn't as big as New York = Boston New York kadar büyük değil (yani daha küçük). Arada sıfatın normal hâli kullanılır: as big as (as bigger as değil). the same as = ile aynı, different from = -den farklı. Which one? = hangisi?
support.ar: as + صفة + as = «مثل» أو «بنفس درجة»: as fast as = سريع مثل. والنفي not as … as = «ليس … مثل»: Boston isn't as big as New York = بوسطن ليست كبيرة مثل نيويورك (أي أصغر). نستخدم الصفة العادية: as big as (وليس as bigger as). the same as = نفس، different from = مختلف عن. Which one? = أيّهما؟

tr.note: as … as arasında -er kullanılmaz; iki as da gerekir.
wrong: My laptop is as faster as yours.
It isn't big as my old one.
right: My laptop is as fast as yours.
It isn't as big as my old one.

ar.note: نحتاج as مرتين، و the قبل same.
wrong: Her phone is same as mine.
He is tall as his brother.
right: Her phone is the same as mine.
He is as tall as his brother.
